subject: Finova - Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Lee <carolyn.lee@finova.com>, Amit Desai <amit.desai@finova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finova - Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Hi Carolyn / Amit -

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view: 

Summary from our side:
- Goal: deploy an LLM-powered agent for customer support triage and document summarization across web and mobile channels.
- Key decision criteria discussed: latency targets for median P95, per-token cost targets, deployment mode (hosted vs. private/VPC), and SLA expectations (uptime / latency SLOs).

Open items / asks for Finova:
1) Economic buyer & approvers: please confirm who owns the budget and final sign-off (we discussed Amit for procurement and Carolyn for product).
2) Security/legal checklist owner: who should we expect to receive the SOC2 questionnaire and security artifacts?
3) Latency & cost targets: can you confirm target P95 latency (goal we heard ~150-200ms for short queries) and any per-1M-token cost thresholds?
4) Deployment preference: do you have a hard requirement for Private (VPC/on-prem) vs. Redwood Hosted? Any constraints from regulation or data residency?

Proposed next steps (I can own coordination):
- I'll send a short decision-criteria template to capture latency/cost/SLA targets and stakeholder mapping - please fill out by end of week. (attached)
- If procurement/legal want to run the SOC2/security questionnaire, Amit can share the contact; we'll turn around evidence within 3 business days after sign-off.
- If everything looks aligned, we'll prepare a short SLA draft and a basic canary plan for a limited pilot (3-4 week timeline).

Attachments: Finova_Decision_Criteria_Template.xlsx (blank template to capture targets / owners)

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference - developer-first inference platform (hosted, dedicated, private)

From: Carolyn Lee <carolyn.lee@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Desai <amit.desai@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget / economic buyer: Amit (cc'd) is the procurement lead and will own the contract/budget approval. Final sign-off will come from Priya N. in the platform org (I'll introduce her once we have a draft).

2) Security/legal owner: I'm copying our security lead, but for thread-level coordination Amit will own procurement steps. The security team prefers to receive questionnaires via DocuSign or a secure link.

3) Latency targets: product team's target for interactive queries is P95 < 200ms for short-text intents (<=128 tokens). For longer document summarization, we're okay with higher tail latency as long as median is under ~400ms. If you have specific benchmarks for hosted vs. private, please share.

4) Cost targets: We're still modeling, but as a rule of thumb procurement will be evaluating options to keep steady-state per-1M-token net cost (including infra & licensing) under $1,200. This is a ballpark - we'll refine with finance.

5) Deployment: Prefer hosted for initial pilot for speed; private/VPC may be required for production depending on security review outcomes. So please provide an outline of differences in SLA and data residency between hosted vs. private.

I'll try to fill the template quickly. Please include a short column for security paperwork owner + expected turnaround time.

Thanks,
Carolyn
Product Lead, Customer Experience | Finova
carolyn.lee@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Lee <carolyn.lee@finova.com>, Amit Desai <amit.desai@finova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Thanks Carolyn - very helpful. I've updated the decision-criteria template and attached it (Finova_Decision_Criteria_Template.xlsx) - a few clarifying notes / asks inline: 

- Latency: we'll map the target P50/P95 for the three canonical workloads you mentioned (short intents, medium contextual prompts, long document summarization). For hosted vs private, attached SLA draft includes separate latency expectations based on isolated dedicated pools vs. multitenant.
- Cost: we'll include modeled per-1M-token estimates for the three workloads under our hosted API and a private deployment (reserved capacity). Those will include estimated infra amortization and quantization/throughput assumptions.
- Security/legal: Neha (copied) is our security/compliance lead - she'll coordinate the SOC2 artifact bundle and can accept questionnaires via secure upload. Neha, if you can outline expected turnaround for the standard Finova questionnaire, that'll help set expectations.

Action items / owners: 
- Carolyn/Amit: fill the attached template with P50/P95 targets and confirm economic buyer (Amit > Priya). DUE: EOD Tue 23 Feb.
- Neha (Redwood): I'll ask you to review Finova_Security_Questionnaire once Amit sends it.
- Monica/Rishi (Redwood): I'll need a short SLA draft and a canary pilot plan by early next week to share with Amit/Priya.

I'm attaching: Finova_Decision_Criteria_Template.xlsx (filled with the fields we discussed).

Thanks - I'll follow up on Monday to see if the template was completed.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Finova_Decision_Criteria_Template.xlsx

Marissa -

Quick note from procurement side: we prefer to run a short procurement window for pilots (standard 30-day PO for pilot, then enterprise negotiations if we expand). A few items: 
- Please send SOC2 + data flow diagram in one package. We'll upload to our secure portal.
- Procurement will need an initial SOW or SLA outline for legal to review; can you provide a 1-2 page SLA summary?
- Finance wants to see modeled monthly cost at expected pilot throughput (~10M tokens/month). If you can include hosted vs. private numbers that'd be great.

I'm attaching our security questionnaire (Finova_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) - security prefers DocuSign/secure link but will accept attachments in initial pass. Please confirm expected turnaround for evidence.

- Redwood (Neha/Monica/Rishi): deliver evidence & SLA/SOW by Tue 23 Feb.
